input.answer:
Toronto was cheaper. In September 2026, regular unleaded gasoline at self-serve stations averaged 183.7 in Toronto versus 209.5 in Vancouver, a gap of 25.8 (209.5 − 183.7 = 25.8). Toronto was about 12.3% below Vancouver (25.8 ÷ 209.5 = 12.3%).

The values are in the units StatCan publishes for this table, which the tool reported as "units" (StatCan normally expresses these as cents per litre). The figures are the monthly average retail prices for September 2026, the latest month in the table's range. No values were suppressed.

Source: Statistics Canada Table 18-10-0001-01, Monthly average retail prices for gasoline and fuel oil, by geography (Toronto and Vancouver, regular unleaded at self-service filling stations).
